system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Skills are loaded and injected into LLM prompts automatically — no manual activation needed.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts come from prompts.default.yaml, with custom_file override. Skills and optional MetaClaw overlays are injected. The prompt-assembly code is not in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Multi-source search (OpenAlex → Semantic Scholar → arXiv) for real papers, screens by relevance, extracts knowledge cards
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value. The pipeline gives the model context through its own literature-retrieval stages, not through model-driven navigation. Whether retrieval is lexical or embedding-based is not stated.

context_compaction.note: No source code for the LLM client or prompt assembly is in the bundle.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Generated code + sandbox results + structured JSON metrics
observation_format.note: This is a pipeline of prompted stages. Observations are text and JSON artifacts.

tool_call_format.note: No parser code is in the evidence. Stages mostly produce plain LLM completions.

tool_count.note: No tool registry is in the evidence.

edit_primitive.note: No edit-tool code is in the evidence. Code generation writes whole files (CodeAgent).

protocol_standardization.note: 'other' is ACP (Agent Client Protocol), used as the LLM backend via acpx.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: a fully autonomous 23-stage research pipeline that turns a single research idea into a conference-ready paper
loop_primitives.note: The experiment stage has a self-healing repair loop, and a PIVOT/REFINE decision at Stage 15. Branch exploration is opt-in.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: LLM decomposes the topic into a structured problem tree with research questions
planning_granularity.note: Stage artifacts, including the problem tree and experiment plan, are persisted and consumed by later stages.

multi_agent_topology.note: BenchmarkAgent runs Surveyor→Selector→Acquirer→Validator and FigureAgent runs Planner→...→Critic. Debate is used in hypothesis generation and review.

delegation_mechanism.note: The ACP backend can delegate Stages 10/13 to external CLI agents. use_sessions_spawn is opt-in.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Gate stages** (5, 9, 20) pause for human approval or auto-approve with `--auto-approve`
human_in_loop.note: HITL is off by default ("Default: OFF"), but security.hitl_required_stages [5,9,20] exist. Six modes are selectable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: SHA256 checksums for all stage artifacts. Immutable manifests for verification.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Lessons extracted per run (decision rationale, runtime warnings, metric anomalies) with 30-day time-decay. Future runs learn from past mistakes.
long_term_memory.note: The knowledge base is markdown under docs/kb. MetaClaw skills in ~/.metaclaw/skills are opt-in.

self_verification.evidence_quote: AST-validated code, immutable harness, NaN/Inf fast-fail, self-healing repair, iterative refinement (up to 10 rounds), partial result capture
self_verification.note: Also multi-agent peer review and a quality gate. The PRM LLM-as-judge is opt-in.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: retry_limit: 2 # Retry count on stage failure
retry_policy.note: These are stage-level retries. The repair loop allows max_cycles: 3.

termination_condition.note: The run ends after the final stage. No value in the list fits, and no run-loop code is available.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Budget monitoring with configurable threshold alerts (50%/80%/100%). Pipeline auto-pauses when cost exceeds budget.
cost_controls.note: cost_budget_usd defaults to 0 (no limit). Beast Mode routes code generation by complexity score.

timeouts.evidence_quote: time_budget_sec: 300 # Max execution time per run (default: 300s)
timeouts.note: The 300 s budget is per experiment execution. approval_timeout_hours is a limit on human waits.

execution_isolation.note: The sandbox runs a local venv python. docker and ssh_remote modes are also available.

network_policy.note: The default sandbox mode has no network option. Docker mode defaults to setup_only.

permission_model.evidence_quote: allowed_imports: [math, random, json, csv, numpy, torch, sklearn]

tracing.evidence_quote: SHA256 checksums for all stage artifacts. Immutable manifests for verification.

guardrails.note: AST validation and import allowlists act as action policies. Unverified numbers are sanitized.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Fully autonomous & self-evolving research from idea to paper.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: provider: "openai-compatible" # openai | openrouter | deepseek | minimax | acp | openai-compatible

first_release_date.evidence_quote: We release AutoResearchClaw: a fully autonomous 23-stage research pipeline
first_release_date.note: Based on the v0.1.0 release news entry (03/15/2026).

stars.note: The evidence contains no star count.
